name: Joseph "Joe" Spitzer

events.place: Cropo Funeral Chapel, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes:
As told to Allan Zelmer by Joe on 24/1/98:

Joe & his family lived in a village of about 50 families called Deutsch Erinsdorf, Austria, very near the Hungarian border. Parents were farmers. His father died in his late 50's - he was never completely well after 1st WW. Mother lived to be 88. Family of 12 children - some died as infants. 7 boys & 3 girls lived.

Joe wanted to emigrate to the USA, but a quota was enforced, so he came to Canada @@ 20 yrs of age. In his earlier days in Canada, he worked in a bush lumber camp as a cook. He has family in Pennsylvania.
